boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-cost ways to spend time together on Illinois Tech’s Mies Campus and around Chicago, with student eligibility or registration requirements noted.

cards.title: Walk the Campus Arboretum
cards.subtitle: A public, no-cost walk among nearly 2,000 trees on Mies Campus
cards.notes: Choose a campus loop, compare tree forms with friends, and use the arboretum landscape as a backdrop for an unhurried outdoor catch-up.
cards.short_summary: Take a free, self-guided social walk through Illinois Tech’s 120-acre campus arboretum.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech states that Alphawood Arboretum covers its 120-acre Mies Campus, contains nearly 2,000 trees, and is free to visit and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; outdoor conditions and individual campus-building access rules may vary.

cards.title: Bowl a Free Game at The BOG
cards.subtitle: Eight-lane student hangout beneath Hermann Hall
cards.notes: Bring classmates for a bowling round, then stay for conversation in the game area; check the page before going because summer closure is posted.
cards.short_summary: Use The BOG’s eight-lane alley for a free on-campus bowling hang.
cards.evidence_claim: The official BOG page explicitly invites visitors to bowl for free in its eight-lane bowling alley.
cards.access_notes: Located on Hermann Hall’s lower level; the venue is closed for summer 2026 and says normal hours will resume in fall.

cards.title: Make Tutoring a Group Session
cards.subtitle: Free peer-supported learning for current Illinois Tech students
cards.notes: Bring one course question each, sign in on arrival, and work through the material together with an ARC tutor when one is available.
cards.short_summary: Turn a difficult assignment into a collaborative, no-charge peer-tutoring meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech states that all Academic Resource Center services are free for current Illinois Tech students and include peer tutoring.
cards.access_notes: Current Illinois Tech students only; visitors must sign in, and immediate tutor availability is not guaranteed.

cards.title: Meet for a Basketball Run
cards.subtitle: Regulation and auxiliary courts for Illinois Tech affiliates
cards.notes: Coordinate a small group, bring proper athletic clothes and shoes, and confirm that general-use court space is open before walking over.
cards.short_summary: Gather classmates for basketball using the courts included with affiliate access.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech’s benefits guide says affiliates may use Keating Sports Center free of charge and identifies basketball among its available facilities.
cards.access_notes: Illinois Tech affiliates must show university ID; courts can close for varsity practices or events, and proper athletic attire is required.

cards.title: Swim Laps Together at Ekco Pool
cards.subtitle: Six-lane pool inside Keating Sports Center
cards.notes: Check the recreational-swim window, meet in the lobby with university IDs, and share an easy lap session while a lifeguard is on duty.
cards.short_summary: Plan a free recreational swim with another Illinois Tech affiliate.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech’s benefits guide says affiliates use Keating free of charge and lists its swimming pool; the athletics site identifies the six-lane Ekco Pool.
cards.access_notes: Illinois Tech affiliates must show university ID; enter only during posted recreational-swim periods when a lifeguard is present.

cards.title: Set Up a Volleyball Rally
cards.subtitle: Indoor court play included for Illinois Tech affiliates
cards.notes: Assemble enough classmates for a casual rally, wear gym shoes, and check facility availability so a varsity booking does not interrupt the plan.
cards.short_summary: Use affiliate access for a no-cost indoor volleyball meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech’s benefits guide states that affiliates can use Keating Sports Center free of charge and lists volleyball as an available facility activity.
cards.access_notes: Illinois Tech affiliates must show university ID; court availability is subject to athletic practices and events.

cards.title: Share a Fitness-Center Workout
cards.subtitle: Cardio, weights, and group fitness for Illinois Tech affiliates
cards.notes: Pick a simple circuit everyone can adapt, arrive in proper training attire, and keep bags in the locker-room area as facility rules require.
cards.short_summary: Exercise alongside friends using Keating’s no-charge affiliate access.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech’s benefits guide says affiliates can use Keating free of charge and lists weight rooms, cardio rooms, and group fitness classes.
cards.access_notes: Illinois Tech affiliates must show university ID; proper training attire is required, and belongings must remain in the locker room.

cards.entity_name: Office of Community Affairs and Outreach Programs
cards.title: Join a Free Community Program
cards.subtitle: Public cultural and educational events organized by Illinois Tech
cards.notes: Review the upcoming-events list with friends, select a screening, talk, or book-club program, and register individually before capacity fills.
cards.short_summary: Attend an Illinois Tech community event together without paying admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech says the office presents cultural events and activities and that, unless noted otherwise, all programs are free to the community with registration required.
cards.source_title: Events | Office of Community Affairs and Outreach Programs
cards.access_notes: Open to the community unless an event states otherwise; advance registration is required for planning purposes.

cards.title: Explore the Cultural Center Galleries
cards.subtitle: Free exhibitions and public rooms beneath two stained-glass domes
cards.notes: Meet beneath the Tiffany dome, browse the current galleries at the same pace, and compare one work each before leaving the building.
cards.short_summary: Spend an admission-free afternoon with art and landmark architecture downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Choose Chicago states that the Chicago Cultural Center is always free for the public to explore and offers free exhibitions and cultural programming.
cards.source_title: Chicago Cultural Center | Find Events, Tours & Architecture
cards.access_notes: Public access requires no ticket; listed building hours are daily 10 a.m.–5 p.m., with holiday closures and earlier gallery closing.

cards.title: Meet at a Free Library Program
cards.subtitle: Recurring public programming in a historic South Side branch
cards.notes: Check the branch calendar together, choose an age-appropriate program, and arrive early enough to find seats without splitting up your group.
cards.short_summary: Use Blackstone Branch’s regularly offered free programs as a neighborhood meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Public Library records that Blackstone Branch delivers free programs regularly and provides free Wi-Fi alongside dedicated adult spaces.
cards.source_title: Board of Directors Meeting Minutes – November 28, 2023
cards.access_notes: Programs are free, but dates, capacity, registration rules, and intended age groups vary; verify the branch calendar before traveling.
